entities.name: Jacob Cornelisz van Oostsanen
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jacob Cornelisz van Oostsanen was a Northern Netherlandish designer of woodcuts and painter. He was one of the first important artists working in Amsterdam, at a time when it was a flourishing and beautiful provincial town.
